class.name: SteamScreenshotOperation
class.brief_description: Retained operation for one annotated Steam screenshot.
class.description: Use [method wait] to await the result, or poll [method is_finished]. Cancelling observation cannot undo a native screenshot write already submitted to Steam.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Stop local observation and skip its pending annotations. Settle the result with [constant ERR_SKIP]. Return [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when already settled.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether the callback, local deadline, cancellation, or scope stop settled the result.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the stored outcome, or [code]null[/code] while observation is pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Return the completion signal while pending, or the same terminal result on every call after settlement.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with the terminal save observation after the handle has been removed from the scope's pending operations.
